intro: "In Favor of Elune" is a rite of passage for young night elf priests ready to step out of the sheltered boughs of Shadowglen. Directed by Priestess Shanda, novitiates travel down the path to Dolanaar to seek further guidance and training under Laurna Morninglight.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, you must travel to Dolanaar when your business here in Shadowglen is done. There, you will find Laurna Morninglight. She will instruct you further in the ways of Elune, and it is with her that you will earn your first garments denoting your station as a priest of Elune.
Take care, and may you be protected in your journeys.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I'm happy to see Shanda has sent you to find me, friend. Teaching young priests the ways of Elune gives me great satisfaction.
